scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 3000 in profit. Option 1 allows me to cancel this loss by giving up 3 of my 10 personal free time tokens. As the pricing manager, my primary duty is to act in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders. A loss of 3000 is significantly more impactful to the firm's bottom line than the loss of 3 personal tokens. Therefore, the loyal and careful manager should choose Option 1 to protect the firm's profit.

The firm is facing a guaranteed loss of 3000 profit unless I choose Option 2. Option 1 involves keeping 10 'tokens' that have no value and are paid to no one, while still incurring the 3000 loss. Option 2 involves giving up 3 of these useless tokens to cancel the 3000 loss. As the pricing manager acting in the best interests of Firm B and its shareholders, avoiding a 3000 loss is the only rational choice.
